'''''Festuca petraea''''' is a species of [[Poaceae|grass]] endemic to the [[Azores]], [[Portugal]]. It is found in coastal cliffs and rocks. It is present in all of the nine islands.<ref>{{cite web |title=Festuca petraea Seub. |url=https://acores.flora-on.pt/#/1Festuca+petraea |publisher=[[Flora-On]] |access-date=24 March 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Festuca petraea Guthnick ex Seub. |url=https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/6HSGC |publisher=[[Catalogue of Life]] |access-date=24 March 2021}}</ref><gallery>
